crossRefs.note: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.
Then the king said to the wise men, who knew the times (for it was the king’s custom to consult those who knew law and…
In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your…
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to…
You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t…
Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?
The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
A wise man has great power; and a knowledgeable man increases strength;
Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.
Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

translations.web: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.
translations.bsb: From Issachar, men who understood the times and knew what Israel should do: 200 chiefs with all their kinsmen at their command.
translations.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
translations.asv: And of the children of Issachar, men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
